Excerpts of the Australian Food Composition Database – Release 3, used by `tests/test_intl_afcd_cnf.py`.

Source: © Food Standards Australia New Zealand. Australian Food Composition Database – Release 3.
Licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
https://www.foodstandards.gov.au/science-data/food-nutrient-databases/afcd

Trimmed on 2026-10-30 from the published workbooks (December 2025). The header rows (1–3) and the rows
for foods F000110 (apple), F007661 (boiled rice), F005634 (cow's milk), F004380 (honey) and F005602
(milk from powder) are copied unchanged; other rows, sheets and formatting were dropped:

- `profiles.xlsx`: sheet "All solids & liquids per 100 g" of "AFCD Release 3 - Nutrient profiles.xlsx",
  plus a placeholder "Contents" sheet.
- `details.xlsx`: sheet "Food details" of "AFCD Release 3 - Food Details.xlsx", plus a placeholder
  "Contents" sheet.
